question: By what power can all those defective mantras ultimately attain success?
premises: All those mantras were previously described as defective.
This attainment occurs by the power of mātṛkā syllables.
inference: All those mantras attain success through the power of the mātṛkā syllables.
plain_english: All those attain success through the power of the syllables of the mātṛkā.
